# vitest

Vite-native testing framework: Jest-compatible API, workspaces, browser mode.

## Stack
- TypeScript ESM monorepo, pnpm 11.28.6 workspaces, v5.1.2, Node ^22.12 || ^24 || >=26 (`package.json:4-9`)
- Rollup/Vite build, oxlint + oxfmt, `tsc -p tsconfig.check.json` typecheck (`package.json:14-37`)

## Commands
- Documented (names only): `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run lint:fix`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm run test:ci`, `pnpm run test:ci:unit`, `pnpm run test:ci:e2e`, `pnpm run test:ci:coverage`, `pnpm run test:browser:playwright`, `pnpm run test:examples`, `pnpm run typecheck`
- Approved for PR review: `pnpm test`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run lint`. Documented is not approved; PR review runs only approved commands.
- Caveat: pool workers load built `dist/workers/*.js` (`packages/vitest/src/node/pools/workers/forksWorker.ts:40`), so `pnpm test` can exercise stale output unless a build ran. The build command is not approved.

## Parts of the code
- [Packages](code/packages/index.md): the 14 `packages/*`; core is [vitest](code/packages/vitest/index.md)
- [Tests](code/test/index.md): `test/` unit, e2e, browser, node-runner, test-utils

## Flows
- [Run tests: CLI to pool to worker to runner](flows/runtime/run-tests/index.md)
- [PR review](flows/pr-review.md)

## Project pages
- [CI/CD](cicd.md) · [Guides](guides/contributing.md) · [Coverage](coverage.md)

## Coverage warnings
- PARTIAL graph. The inventory is `complete:false` and under 3% of files were read. Unexplored: vitest `node/{reporters,config,environments,sequencers,cache,vcs,api,browser}`, `integrations`, `typecheck`, `vm` runtime, `packages/ui/client`, `docs/`, `examples/`, `scripts/`, most `.github/`. Three publish workflows were excluded by the inventory as secret-content. See [coverage](coverage.md).

## Dependencies
- None cross-repository (workspace only). CI uses the ghcr.io `playwright-deps` image and the npm registry.

# CI/CD

Parent: [PROJECT](PROJECT.md)
Scope: .github/workflows/*, .github/actions/**, .github/docker/**
Uses: none

Descriptive map of `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (read in full). Command names only.

- Triggers: push to `main`, pull_request (opened, synchronize, reopened, closed), `workflow_dispatch` (`ci.yml:7-15`). Concurrency cancels in-progress runs per PR or ref (`:17-19`). Default permissions are `{}` (`:5`).
- Jobs:
  - `lint` (`:29`): `pnpm dedupe --check`, install `pnpm i --filter '!docs'`, `pnpm run build`, `pnpm -C docs run cli-table`, `git diff --exit-code` (stale artifacts), `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run -C packages/ui typecheck:client`, actionlint.
  - `changed` (`:75`): skips tests when only docs, markdown or non-ci `.github` files changed.
  - `playwright-deps-image` (`:103`): builds and pushes a ghcr.io image only if its tag is missing; fork PRs cannot push.
  - `test` (`:151`): matrix suite unit/e2e/coverage on ubuntu node 24 and 26; extra legs e2e node 22, e2e macOS, unit/e2e/coverage on Windows node 24. Runs `pnpm run test:ci:<suite>`, then `pnpm run test:examples` (unit, ubuntu) and `pnpm -C packages/ui test:ui`. Uploads results as artifacts.
  - `test-browser-windows` (`:259`) and `test-browser-linux` (`:309`): `pnpm run test:browser:playwright`, sharded; Windows isolates `runner.test.ts`; Linux runs in the playwright-deps container.
  - `test-vite7` (`:367`): `pnpm override-vite7`, then e2e and the browser `runner.test.ts` smoke.
  - `merge-reports` (`:439`): merges blob reports into html artifacts.
- Other workflows (names only, not read): ai-policy, approve-contributor, cr, ecosystem-ci-trigger, issue-close-require, issue-labeled, knip, lock-closed-issues, pr-redirect-all, semgrep, zizmor. Excluded by the inventory as secret-content: `prepare-publish.yml`, `promote-docs.yml`, `publish.yml`, so the release flow is unmapped. Root scripts `release` and `publish-ci` run `scripts/release.ts` and `scripts/publish-ci.ts` (not read).
- Pitfalls:
  - Actions are pinned to commit SHAs. Several `uses:` lines read `$/.github/actions/...` (`:42`, `:202`); this is probably a sanitization artefact in the file read, unconfirmed.
  - Actionlint is downloaded with `curl ... | bash` from the `main` branch (`:72`).
  - The test steps carry `# zizmor: ignore[template-injection]` (`:218`, `:307`).
  - `PNPM_CONFIG_TRUST_LOCKFILE` is true except in the lint job (`:26`, `:36`).
- Tests of CI itself: none. The matrix table is mirrored in `test/README.md:29-42`.

# packages

Parent: [PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md)
Scope: packages/*/package.json
Uses: none

Index of the 14 published workspace packages. Each owns one responsibility.

- Entry points: workspace build is `package.json:14` (`pnpm -r ... run build`); tests resolve packages through built `dist/`.
- Public surface and routing:
  - [vitest](vitest/index.md): CLI, node API, pools, test runtime. The core package.
  - [browser](browser/index.md), [browser-playwright](browser-playwright/index.md), [browser-preview](browser-preview/index.md): browser mode and its providers.
  - [ui](ui/index.md): web UI served through a Vite plugin.
  - [expect](expect/index.md), [spy](spy/index.md), [snapshot](snapshot/index.md), [pretty-format](pretty-format/index.md): assertions, mocks, snapshots, serialization.
  - [mocker](mocker/index.md): module mocking and hoisting transforms.
  - [coverage-v8](coverage-v8/index.md), [coverage-istanbul](coverage-istanbul/index.md): coverage providers.
  - [utils](utils/index.md): shared helpers via subpath exports.
  - [web-worker](web-worker/index.md): `Worker` and `SharedWorker` simulation in Node.

- Pitfalls: `packages/vitest` and `packages/browser` expose an `__vitest_source__` export condition (see `packages/browser/package.json:34`) that resolves workspace packages from TypeScript source. This is the source-level reason for the "rebuild before testing" caveat. Team note, unverified: only `@vitest/mocker` is not inlined into the vitest bundle.

Scope: packages/vitest/src/node/pool.ts, packages/vitest/src/node/pools/**

Schedules spec files onto worker processes or threads and relays RPC between the main process and workers.

- Entry points:
  - `src/node/pool.ts:44` `createPool(ctx)` returns a `ProcessPool` (`runTests`, `collectTests`, `close`).
  - `pool.ts:58` `executeTests` groups specs and builds `PoolTask`s.
  - `src/node/pools/pool.ts:32` class `Pool`: `run` `:57`, `schedule` `:73`, `cancel` `:212`, `close` `:242`.
  - `pools/poolRunner.ts:49` class `PoolRunner` (state machine IDLE to STOPPED, `:21`).
  - `pools/rpc.ts:35` `createMethodsRPC` (module `fetch` `:93`, `fetchWarmModules` `:96`).

  - `pools/browser.ts:41` `createBrowserPool`.
- Public surface: `ProcessPool`, `getFilePoolName` (`pool.ts:37`: browser enabled gives `'browser'`, otherwise `config.pool`), `PoolRunner` and `ForksPoolWorker` (marked `@experimental`; `ForksPoolWorker` is imported from `vitest/node` in `test/e2e/test/pool.test.ts:5`). Consumed by `Vitest.runFiles` (`core.ts:1067`).
- Run/test this part: `pnpm run test:ci:e2e` (documented); focused file `test/e2e/test/pool.test.ts`.
- Extension points:
  - Custom pool: `Pool.getPoolRunner` builds `new PoolRunner(options, customPool.createPoolWorker(options))` (`pools/pool.ts:286`); the interface is in `pools/types.ts` (`createPoolWorker` at `:13`). Fixtures: `test/e2e/fixtures/custom-pool*`, test `test/e2e/test/custom-pool.test.ts`.

  - Workers start from `resolve(distPath, 'workers/forks.js')` (`forksWorker.ts:40`), so runtime changes need a rebuild.
  - Worker start timeout 90s (`pools/pool.ts:14`); `PoolRunner` start and stop timeouts are 60s each (`poolRunner.ts:45-46`).
  - Specs in one group share `maxWorkers`; two projects with the same `sequence.groupOrder` but different `maxWorkers` throw (`pool.ts:389-395`).
  - Non-isolated single-worker projects batch files into one run request, except vmThreads and vmForks (`pool.ts:402-417`).
  - The V8 compile cache is disabled for non-istanbul coverage providers (`pool.ts:119-122`).

  - Second Ctrl+C forces a kill (`pools/pool.ts:213-215`).
  - vm pools get a memory limit via `getMemoryLimit` (`pool.ts:287`).

  - `runtime/worker.ts:14` `execute`, exported as `run` (`:85`), `collect` (`:89`), `teardown` (`:93`).
  - `workers/base.ts:88` `setupBaseEnvironment`, `:148` `runBaseTests`.
  - `runtime/runBaseTests.ts:23` `run`.
  - `runtime/runner/run.ts:1054` `startTests` (collect, then `runFiles` `:1020`, then `runTest` `:584`, `runSuite` `:866`).

Alternative module runner: `config.experimental.viteModuleRunner === false` switches to `NativeModuleRunner` and node loader hooks (`base.ts:42-67`, `:91-100`).

# Decisions

Each entry has a source and date. Changes go through `/devocd:capture`.

## D-0001 — `packages/expect` stays runtime-agnostic
Date: 2026-10-02

`packages/expect` must not import Node.js built-ins (`node:*`) or read the filesystem, directly or
through a dependency it bundles: the package is also bundled into browser and edge runtimes. A
matcher that needs a host capability takes it from `packages/vitest` at runtime instead.

## D-0002 — No shared internal package for cross-package helpers
Date: 2026-10-08

A `@vitest/shared` package was created on 2026-09-17 to hold helpers duplicated across packages
(`isPlainObject`, `format`, `getType`) and reverted on 2026-10-01: two bundles ended up with
separate copies of its module-level state, so `expect` and `snapshot` saw different instances under
HMR. Helpers stay duplicated per package; add one to `@vitest/utils` only when it holds no state.

## D-0003 — Pool and scheduler changes need the performance owner
Date: 2026-10-14

Changes under `packages/vitest/src/node/pool.ts`, `poolRunner.ts`, `pools/` or `watchdog.ts` need an
approving review from the performance owner (GitHub team `@vitest/perf`) before merge, even when CI
is green. The author does not merge such a change themselves.

## D-0004 — `.snap` files are generated; update with `-u` only
Date: 2026-10-20

Snapshot files are output, not source. A failing snapshot is fixed by running the suite with `-u`
(or `--update`) and committing the regenerated file; the runner rewrites `.snap` files on the next
run, so a hand edit is lost and is rejected in review.

## D-0005 — Release from main; bump, then tag the merge commit
Date: 2026-10-26

A release bumps the version in the root `package.json` and in every published package's
`package.json` in one pull request to `main`, merged only after CI is green on Linux, macOS and
Windows. A maintainer creates the `vX.Y.Z` tag on that merge commit on `main`. Feature or release
branches are never tagged.

## D-0006 — Browser-mode tests are nightly only
Date: 2026-11-01

`test:browser` runs on the nightly schedule and before a release, not on every pull request. A pull
request that changes browser code runs the unit suite only; a nightly failure blocks the release.

## D-0007 — No new runtime dependencies in `packages/expect`
Date: 2026-11-04

`packages/expect` ships in every install. A new runtime dependency needs an explicit decision
before it merges; small helpers are inlined instead.

## D-0008 — Security reports go to the private advisory channel
Date: 2026-11-06

A suspected vulnerability is reported through GitHub's private security advisory, never as a public
issue or pull request. The maintainer who receives it coordinates the fix and the disclosure date.

## D-0009 — Public API changes need a migration note
Date: 2026-11-09

A change to an exported type or function in a published package adds a note under
`docs/guide/migration.md` in the same pull request, so the next release can link to it.

## D-0010 — Documentation examples use pnpm
Date: 2026-11-11

Code examples in `docs/` and in package READMEs use `pnpm`, matching the workspace's package
manager. npm and yarn commands are shown only where a page compares package managers.

# Flow: CLI to pool to worker to runner

Parent: [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md)
Scope: packages/vitest/src/node/cli/**, packages/vitest/src/node/core.ts, packages/vitest/src/node/pool.ts, packages/vitest/src/node/pools/**, packages/vitest/src/runtime/**
Uses: none

Descriptive map of `vitest run` with the default forks pool. Not the PR-review policy. Subflow: [worker protocol](worker-protocol.md).

1. `packages/vitest/src/node/cli.ts:3` `createCLI().parse()`. `cli/cac.ts:74` registers commands; the `run` handler (`:268`) calls `start` (`:302`), which imports `./cli-api` lazily (`:304`).
2. `cli/cli-api.ts:97` `startVitest` runs `prepareVitest` (`:223`; core is built in `create.ts:25-55`), checks coverage package install (`:123-133`), then `ctx.start(cliFilters)` (`:167`).
3. `core.ts:860` `Vitest.start`: coverage init, `specifications.getRelevantTestSpecifications` (`:883`), shard (`:900`), `runFiles` (`:927`).
4. `core.ts:1050` `runFiles`: creates the pool once (`:1066-1068`), global setup (`:1080`), sequencer sort, `pool.runTests(sorted, invalidates)` (`:1092-1093`), cache update, coverage report in `finally` (`:1105-1110`).
5. `node/pool.ts:44` `createPool` to `executeTests` (`:58`): groups specs (`groupSpecs` `:311`), builds `PoolTask` per spec group with env, `execArgv`, `isolate`, `memoryLimit` (`:140-163`); browser specs go to `createBrowserPool` (`:189-191`); each group calls `pool.setMaxWorkers` then `pool.run` (`:170-178`).
6. `pools/pool.ts:57` `Pool.run` queues; `schedule` (`:73`) gets a `PoolRunner`, starts it, then `runner.request(method, task.context)` (`:154`) and waits for `testfileFinished` (`:102-114`). A non-isolated runner may be reused for the next queued task (`:166-175`); otherwise it stops (`:177-199`).
7. Worker: `pools/workers/forksWorker.ts:40` forks `dist/workers/forks.js`. That is `runtime/workers/forks.ts:4`, `init-forks.ts:32`, `init.ts:79`. See [worker protocol](worker-protocol.md).
8. `runtime/worker.ts:14` `execute` calls `worker.runTests(state)`, then `workers/base.ts:148` `runBaseTests`, then `runtime/runBaseTests.ts:23` `run`, then `runtime/runner/run.ts:1054` `startTests`.
9. Back-channel: `PoolRunner` creates a birpc channel with `createMethodsRPC` (`poolRunner.ts:109-114`, `pools/rpc.ts:35`); workers fetch modules through `fetch` (`rpc.ts:93`). Results land in `state` and `TestRun` (`test-run.ts:44`, `:164`) and reach reporters.

- Pitfalls: errors from tasks are aggregated into one `AggregateError` (`pool.ts:199-208`) and recorded as `Unhandled Error` (`core.ts:1094-1096`). Cancellation rejects with `'Cancelled'`, which is handled specially (`pool.ts:181-183`).
- Not traced: vm pools, threads, typecheck pool, browser pool internals, reporter dispatch.
- Tests: `test/e2e/test/pool.test.ts`, `cancel-run.test.ts`, `custom-pool.test.ts`, `pool-worker-exit.test.ts` (last three by name only).
- Pages that own the code: [node](../../../code/packages/vitest/src/node/index.md), [pools](../../../code/packages/vitest/src/node/pools/index.md), [runtime](../../../code/packages/vitest/src/runtime/index.md).

# Subflow: worker message protocol

Parent: [Flow: CLI to pool to worker to runner](index.md)
Scope: packages/vitest/src/runtime/workers/init.ts, packages/vitest/src/runtime/workers/init-forks.ts, packages/vitest/src/runtime/worker.ts
Uses: none

How a worker process talks to `PoolRunner` after being forked.

- Entry points: `runtime/workers/init.ts:79` `init(worker)`; `onMessage` at `:95`. Requests carry `__vitest_worker_request__: true` (`:98`); responses carry `__vitest_worker_response__` (`:47`).
- Messages:
  - `start` (`:103`): sets `VITEST_POOL_ID` and `VITEST_WORKER_ID`, inits tracing, creates the runtime RPC and calls `worker.setup`, replies `started` (with an error on failure).
  - `run` (`:147`) and `collect` (`:207`): call `entrypoint.run/collect` (`runtime/worker.ts:85`, `:89`), flush stdio, reply `testfileFinished` with the serialized error and `usedMemory` when `reportMemory`.
  - `stop` (`:271`): awaits the running promise, runs teardown, flushes the compile cache, replies `stopped`, then `worker.teardown()`.
- Forks specifics (`init-forks.ts`): requires `process.send` (`:5-7`). `ERR_IPC_CHANNEL_CLOSED` or `EPIPE` makes the worker exit 1 (`:60-62`). A `disconnect` also exits 1 (`:66-68`). Teardown restores the real `process.exit` (`:49`).
- Pitfalls:
  - A second `run` while one is active returns `testfileFinished` with error "Worker is already running tests" (`:149-156`).
  - `flushStdio` awaits an empty write callback because `thread.terminate()` would otherwise drop buffered output (comment `:56-63`).
  - `Module.flushCompileCache` is read from the default import because a named import fails to link before Node 22.10 (`:5-7`).
  - The RPC is not closed on cleanup; pending calls are rejected with `EnvironmentTeardownError` (`worker.ts:29-38`).
- Tests: `test/e2e/test/pool.test.ts` (stdout/stderr capture), `pool-worker-exit.test.ts` (name only).
